title: Reporting for Sustainability
reference: Brčeski, I., Laušević, R. (Eds) (2013): Reporting for Sustainability. Conference Proceedings. 7-10 May 2013, Becici, Montenegro. Regional Environmental Center, Country Office Serbia. ISBN 978-86-7550-070-4. 512 pp.
venue: Conference Proceedings. 7-10 May 2013, Becici, Montenegro; ISBN 978-86-7550-070-4
publisher: Regional Environmental Center, Country Office Serbia
description:
This Proceedings includes the plenary lectures, papers by invited speakers and accepted papers presented orally or on the posters at the International Science Conference “Reporting for Sustainability”. The Conference took place in Bečići (Montenegro) at the Mediteran Hotel Congress Center, May 7-10, 2013.

There is much more to sustainability reporting than just generating reports on collected data requested by relevant legislation. It is becoming an increasingly comprehensive method of demonstration of an organization’s commitment to sustainable development in transparent and traceable way, presented to both internal and external stakeholders. This Conference was organized within the project “Setting up Environmental Management Center in Serbia”, implemented by the Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe with the funds provided by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Norway. Therefore, the Conference represented an excellent opportunity to discuss newly developed tools for integrated environmental reporting and sustainability reporting in Serbia. However, many other tools and practical approaches implemented in Southeastern Europe were discussed.

The Conference was also a unique regional platform for networking with the environmental management community in Serbia and Southeastern Europe. The Conference offered ample opportunities for interaction and exchange between academicians, government officials and sustainability practitioners. We hope that this Proceedings will be used by professionals across the world and will remain as a valuable reference source in the times to come.
